svg.text: In this kind of mixture, you can distinguish some pieces of corn, banana, beans and other materials that make up the mixture in halo-halo. The mixed materials can be classified depending on the appearance of the resulting mixture. Each of the combined/mixed materials can be identified or distinguished from one another. This kind of mixture is called heterogeneous mixture. Each property of the materials in heterogeneous mixtures do not change.
